Title: LLMs Generate Relevant and Accurate Design Decisions but Not Human‑Level Performance  
Claim: Large language models can produce design decisions that are relevant and accurate, yet they have not yet achieved performance comparable to human experts.  
Evidence: LLMs can successfully generate relevant and accurate design decisions, though they do not yet reach humanlevel performance.  
Labels: Empirical Study, LLM Capabilities, Software Architecture Design  
Conditions: Based on the exploratory empirical study by Dhar et al.  
Limits: Findings are limited to the specific design decision contexts examined in the study and may not generalize to all architectural scenarios.

Title: LLMs Contain Software Architectural Knowledge  
Claim: Large language models possess knowledge about software architecture that can be accessed to answer questions about existing systems.  
Evidence: LLMs do indeed contain software architectural knowledge.  
Labels: Exploratory Case Study, LLM Knowledge, Software Architecture  
Conditions: Derived from the exploratory case study by Sliman and Keim.  
Limits: The study evaluated LLM responses to questions about architectural knowledge of existing software systems; it does not assess the depth or completeness of that knowledge across all architectural domains.
